nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.paths
=================================

.. py:module:: nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.paths

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Filesystem layout helpers for the PESA-Fat CT-PET / Dixon batches.

   The pipelines operate on a flat on-disk tree rooted at three top-level
   directories:

   * ``DICOM_ROOT / <batch> / PESA* / ...``   (inputs)
   * ``NIFTI_ROOT / <batch> / PESA* / ...``   (stage 0 outputs + inputs to later stages)
   * ``RESULTS_ROOT / <batch> / res_<stage>/PESA* / ...``   (later-stage outputs)

   All pipelines derive their per-subject paths from :class:`BatchLayout`.

.. py:function:: resolve_nii(parent: pathlib.Path, stem: str) -> pathlib.Path

   Return the existing ``parent/stem.nii[.gz]``, preferring ``.nii.gz``.


.. py:function:: resolve_nii_optional(parent: pathlib.Path, stem: str) -> pathlib.Path | None

   Variant of :func:`resolve_nii` returning ``None`` instead of raising.


.. py:function:: parse_subjects(value: str | None) -> list[str] | None

   Turn ``"PESA001,PESA002"`` into a list (or ``None`` when empty).


.. py:class:: BatchLayout

   Resolved directories for a specific batch run.


   .. py:attribute:: batch
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: dicom_root
      :type:  pathlib.Path


   .. py:attribute:: nifti_root
      :type:  pathlib.Path


   .. py:attribute:: results_root
      :type:  pathlib.Path


   .. py:attribute:: model_root
      :type:  pathlib.Path


   .. py:property:: dicom_dir
      :type: pathlib.Path


      This batch's DICOM directory.


   .. py:property:: nifti_dir
      :type: pathlib.Path


      This batch's NIfTI directory.


   .. py:property:: results_dir
      :type: pathlib.Path


      This batch's results directory.


   .. py:property:: model_dir
      :type: pathlib.Path


      The TotalSegmentator model root (not batch-scoped).


   .. py:method:: stage_dir(stage_name: str) -> pathlib.Path

      Return ``results_dir / f"res_{stage_name}"``.



   .. py:method:: subject_nifti_dir(subject: str) -> pathlib.Path

      *subject*'s NIfTI directory within this batch.



   .. py:method:: subject_dicom_dir(subject: str) -> pathlib.Path

      *subject*'s DICOM directory within this batch.



   .. py:method:: subject_nifti_dirs() -> list[pathlib.Path]

      Return all ``PESA*`` subject directories under ``nifti_dir`` (sorted).



   .. py:method:: subject_dicom_dirs() -> list[pathlib.Path]

      Return all ``PESA*`` subject directories under ``dicom_dir`` (sorted).



   .. py:method:: iter_subjects() -> Iterator[str]

      Yield subject names (directory basenames) from the NIfTI layout.



.. py:function:: default_submit_script_path(batch: str) -> pathlib.Path

   Return ``SCRIPTS_CLUSTER/submit_<batch>.sh`` under :data:`DEFAULT_SGE_SCRIPTS_DIR`.


.. py:function:: layout(batch: str, *, dicom_root: pathlib.Path | str | None = None, nifti_root: pathlib.Path | str | None = None, results_root: pathlib.Path | str | None = None, model_root: pathlib.Path | str | None = None) -> BatchLayout

   Build a :class:`BatchLayout` for ``batch``, falling back to defaults.


.. py:function:: layout_local(batch: str, *, dicom_root: pathlib.Path | str | None = None, nifti_root: pathlib.Path | str | None = None, results_root: pathlib.Path | str | None = None, model_root: pathlib.Path | str | None = None) -> BatchLayout

   Workstation layout for XNAT download and ``--submit local``.

   Uses ``pipelines.pesa_fat_paths.local_*`` from ``.nvitk/sge.json`` when CLI
   ``--*-root`` flags are omitted (never the cluster ``cluster_*`` / ``DEFAULT_*`` paths).


.. py:function:: layout_cluster(batch: str, *, dicom_root: pathlib.Path | str | None = None, nifti_root: pathlib.Path | str | None = None, results_root: pathlib.Path | str | None = None, model_root: pathlib.Path | str | None = None) -> BatchLayout

   Cluster-side :class:`BatchLayout` for SGE binds and SFTP upload targets.

   Reads ``pipelines.pesa_fat_paths`` from ``.nvitk/sge.json`` when set;
   otherwise falls back to CLI ``--*-root`` flags or :data:`DEFAULT_*_ROOT`.


.. py:function:: group_subjects_by_batch(download_map: dict[str, tuple[str, dict]]) -> dict[str, list[str]]

   Group XNAT download results ``{subject: (batch, paths)}`` by batch name.
